svg.text: Transform: Spark notebooks build Silver and Gold, and train and score LightGBM and logistic-regression models.

svg.text: Serve: the API reads Gold tables straight from OneLake (Delta), caches results and preloads the featured match.

svg.text: Watch: the web app calls the API over REST and opens a WebSocket replay; one match clock drives every view.

svg.text: Ask: Foundry agents answer questions by calling the API’s match tools, which never see past the replay clock.
